## What changed

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] UX or accessibility improvement

## Evidence

- [ ] I ran `npm run verify:final` (or explained why a smaller check is sufficient).

- [ ] Preview and export produce equivalent results.

## Verification

List commands, browser scenarios, and any intentionally skipped checks.
